title.narrative: Establishment and Operation of a National Cleaner Production Programme (NCPP) in Ecuador

description.narrative: During Phase I, UNIDO will provide technical assistance to the Government of Ecuador in developing the strategic approach for a sust ainable National RECP Centre/Programme that is supported by key stakeholders from government, business sector and civil society, and that delivers value-adding RECP services to industry. In the course of developing the document for a five year programme, UNIDO will undertake fund raising activities in close cooperation with the local stakeholders and work with a number of national companies and experts in testing and adopting the UNIDO RECP methodology to the national context. Specific focus will be placed on creating synergies and enhancing cooperation and coordination with other on-going UNIDO projects in the country (e.g. energy, POPs, Montreal Protocol) and on including gender relevant issues in the final project document.
